build_MidasNet_model: build a MidasNet monocular depth estimation model with resnext101_wsl backbone and 256 features
run_MidasNet_forward: run the MidasNet forward pass on an input image tensor to predict depth
load_MidasNet_weights: load pretrained MidasNet model weights from a saved checkpoint file path
review_MidasNet_architecture: review the MidasNet class architecture with four FeatureFusionBlock cascades and output convolution layers
summarize_MidasNet_forward_pass: summarize the MidasNet forward pass that extracts features through pretrained layers and refines them
